rules.statement: A gift can be revoked for ingratitude even though the donor expressly agreed that it should be irrevocable.
rules.supporting_quote: All that section 9 of Cap. 48 does is to remove a bar imposed by the Roman-Dutch law on gifts between husband and wife. But there is no enactment which says that the common law does not apply to such gifts.
